findings.details: The V3-to-V2 diff contains only the documented optional-file handling change plus its local explanatory docstring and directory-identity plumbing. On the existing exact terminal-success branch, V3 tries the same bounded regular-file capture for VERIFICATION.json. It converts only FileNotFoundError into `{"bytes":0,"present":false,"absence":"not_found"}` after confirming the output directory remains the same real directory by device/inode and rechecking that the file is still absent. Symlinks, oversize files, permission failures, other I/O errors, directory replacement, and a file that reappears remain errors. The absence contributes zero bytes to the existing aggregate cap.

The V2 reader required VERIFICATION.json after its terminal-success predicate, while the V5 producer's runner calls checker.verify_terminal(), prints the result as JSON, and does not write VERIFICATION.json. The producer routes both stdout and stderr to D/unit.log. V3 therefore records the optional file's absence and continues capturing the required VERIFIER_ADMISSION.json, VERIFIER_LAUNCH.json, and unit.log. This handles the reported V2 FileNotFoundError after terminal success without labeling it a checker failure.

V3 captures unit.log as a required bounded file and does not parse its JSON line, create a VERIFICATION.json, or relabel log content as that file. Root must separately pin the captured log and derive any final JSON-line record and offset from those exact bytes. The V3 absence marker alone establishes only that VERIFICATION.json was not found during this capture.

Source diff and the pinned AST binding preserve all five root-bound receipt/invocation slots as fail-closed unbound values, admission/launch identity and schema checks, exact support invocation check, parent/own cgroup and selected-GPU observations, seven exact private-code pins, the required three-file capture set, and the 1 MB per-file / 4 MB aggregate caps. No support-unit mutation or model/data payload read is added.

The fixture source checks normalized V2/V3 AST equality, the FileNotFoundError-only absence branch and directory identity check, required captures, the V5 runner's final JSON print, no VERIFICATION.json write, and stdout/stderr redirection to unit.log. It parses source and synthetic AST metadata; I did not execute the fixture, Ruff, or any production module.
